notes: NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no row for this province; Later Mayan City-States (1429-1546, 135,136 to 187,745 km2) covers the whole northern lowlands and contains it. The Kuchkabal page says the extent of the provinces 'is still debated' and that scholars disagree 'on whether they were territorial units or jurisdictions'; the shape here is a disc around the capital, soft, and no frontier is claimed. Cliopatria keeps its envelope to 1546 although the Spanish took the provinces one by one from 1527. EKAB. The page says Ekab was 'an exception to the usual kuchkabal model' (oligarchy of batabilob). Gazetteer lacks 'Ekab', 'Xelha' and 'Cape Catoche'. The Spanish settlement at Xelha in 1527-28 is only in the war entry because no page dates its end.
